entities.name: Query protein (237 aa)
observations: Sequence-derived: 237 aa; estimated mass 26.9 kDa; theoretical pI 9.78; predicted net charge at pH 7 is +11.1.

Moderate homology support for UbiE, an S-adenosylmethionine-dependent ubiquinone/menaquinone C-methyltransferase: best reviewed matches are 42.1% identity and 95.8% query coverage (E=9.63e-59), with an independent 41.7% identity match.
Pfam scan detected Ubie_methyltran (PF01209.25), residues 11–235, i-Evalue 1.3e-50.
Homolog annotations indicate methylation steps in menaquinone and ubiquinone biosynthesis; exact substrate specificity is inferred, not directly established for this query sequence.
